targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(usage_start) as time,
  provider || ' / ' || COALESCE(service_name, 'unknown') as metric,
  SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(net_cost_usd, 0), cost_usd)) as value
FROM cost_records
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(usage_start)
  AND provider IN ($provider)
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(net_cost_usd, 0), cost_usd))::numeric, 2) as mtd
FROM cost_records
WHERE
  usage_start >= date_trunc('month', current_date)
  AND provider IN ($provider)
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(net_cost_usd, 0), cost_usd))::numeric, 2) as prev
FROM cost_records
WHERE
  usage_start >= date_trunc('month', current_date - INTERVAL '1 month')
  AND usage_start < date_trunc('month', current_date)
  AND provider IN ($provider)
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)

WITH days_elapsed AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM current_date)::int AS n
),
mtd AS (
  SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(net_cost_usd, 0), cost_usd)) as val
  FROM cost_records, days_elapsed
  WHERE usage_start >= date_trunc('month', current_date)
    AND usage_start < date_trunc('month', current_date) + (n || ' days')::interval
    AND provider IN ($provider)
    AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
    AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
    AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
    AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
    AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
    AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
),
prev AS (
  SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(net_cost_usd, 0), cost_usd)) as val
  FROM cost_records, days_elapsed
  WHERE usage_start >= date_trunc('month', current_date - INTERVAL '1 month')
    AND usage_start < date_trunc('month', current_date - INTERVAL '1 month') + (n || ' days')::interval
    AND provider IN ($provider)
    AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
    AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
    AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
    AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
    AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
    AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
)
SELECT ROUND(((mtd.val - prev.val) / NULLIF(prev.val, 0)) * 100, 2) as growth
FROM mtd, prev

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) as count FROM cost_records
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(usage_start)
  AND provider IN ($provider)
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)

SELECT
  service_name,
  SUM(cost_usd) as total_cost
FROM cost_records
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(usage_start)
  AND provider IN ($provider)
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  resource_type,

SELECT
  charge_type,
  SUM(cost_usd) as total_cost
FROM cost_records

  $__timeFilter(usage_start)

SELECT
  service_name,
  region,
  resource_type,
  charge_type,
  COUNT(*) as records,
  ROUND(SUM(cost_usd)::numeric, 2) as total_cost
FROM cost_records
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(usage_start)
  AND provider IN ($provider)
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

SELECT
  COALESCE(project_name, '(no project)') as project,
  provider,
  COUNT(*) as records,
  ROUND(SUM(cost_usd)::numeric, 2) as mtd_cost
FROM cost_records
WHERE
  usage_start >= date_trunc('month', current_date)
  AND provider IN ($provider)
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 4 DESC

SELECT
  provider,
  service_name,
  region,
  ROUND(SUM(cost_usd)::numeric, 2) as total_cost,
  COUNT(*) as records
FROM cost_records
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(usage_start)
  AND provider IN ($provider)
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC

SELECT
  model_name,
  ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)::numeric, 0) as avg_latency_ms,
  SUM(input_tokens) as total_input_tokens,
  SUM(output_tokens) as total_output_tokens,
  SUM(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
  ROUND(SUM(cost_usd)::numeric, 2) as total_cost
FROM cost_records
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(usage_start)
  AND provider = 'llm'
  AND model_name IS NOT NULL
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 6 DESC

WITH mtd AS (
  SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(net_cost_usd, 0), cost_usd)) as val
  FROM cost_records
  WHERE usage_start >= date_trunc('month', current_date)
    AND provider IN ($provider)
    AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
    AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
    AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
    AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
    AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
    AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
),
days AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM current_date)::int AS elapsed,
         EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_trunc('month', current_date) + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day')::int AS total
)
SELECT ROUND((mtd.val / NULLIF(days.elapsed, 0) * days.total)::numeric, 2) as forecast
FROM mtd, days

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT DATE(usage_start) as day, SUM(cost_usd) as cost_usd
  FROM cost_records
  WHERE usage_start >= now() - INTERVAL '60 days'
    AND provider IN ($provider)
    AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
    AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
    AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
    AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
    AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
    AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(cost_usd) as mean, STDDEV(cost_usd) as stddev FROM daily
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as value
FROM daily, stats
WHERE cost_usd > mean + 2 * stddev
  AND day >= date_trunc('month', current_date)

panels.title: Today vs Same Day Last Month

targets.rawSql:
WITH today AS (
  SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(net_cost_usd, 0), cost_usd)) as val
  FROM cost_records
  WHERE DATE(usage_start) = current_date
    AND provider IN ($provider)
    AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
    AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
    AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
    AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
    AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
    AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
),
same_day_last_month AS (
  SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(net_cost_usd, 0), cost_usd)) as val
  FROM cost_records
  WHERE DATE(usage_start) = current_date - INTERVAL '1 month'
    AND provider IN ($provider)
    AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
    AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
    AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
    AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
    AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
    AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
)
SELECT ROUND(((today.val - same_day_last_month.val) / NULLIF(same_day_last_month.val, 0)) * 100, 2) as change_pct
FROM today, same_day_last_month

SELECT
  service_name,
  usage_unit,
  ROUND(SUM(cost_usd)::numeric, 2) as total_cost,
  ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity)::numeric, 2) as total_quantity,
  ROUND((SUM(cost_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(usage_quantity), 0))::numeric, 6) as cost_per_unit
FROM cost_records
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(usage_start)
  AND usage_quantity IS NOT NULL
  AND usage_unit IS NOT NULL
  AND provider IN ($provider)
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
GROUP BY service_name, usage_unit
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Daily Cost Anomaly Detection

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(usage_start) as time,
  ROUND(SUM(cost_usd)::numeric, 2) as value
FROM cost_records
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(usage_start)
  AND provider IN ($provider)
  AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
  AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
  AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
  AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
  AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
  AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  null as time,
  ROUND((AVG(daily_cost) + 2 * STDDEV(daily_cost))::numeric, 2) as value
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(cost_usd) as daily_cost
  FROM cost_records
  WHERE usage_start >= now() - INTERVAL '60 days'
    AND provider IN ($provider)
    AND (project_name IN ($project) OR project_name IS NULL)
    AND (region IN ($region) OR region IS NULL)
    AND (service_name IN ($service) OR service_name IS NULL)
    AND (resource_type IN ($resource_type) OR resource_type IS NULL)
    AND (environment IN ($environment) OR environment IS NULL)
    AND (team IN ($team) OR team IS NULL)
  GROUP BY DATE(usage_start)
) sub
